title: 第475章 远古隐秘第474章 宇宙悍匪
content_zh:
片刻后。
一道剑光直接冲入未知之地。
许渊放眼望去。
发现这方星球也有陆地以及海洋。
只是整片海洋仿佛被什么诡异的东西污染。
呈现一种墨黑色。
而且极为粘稠。
在这片不断翻滚，蠕动的墨色海洋之中，似乎存在着一些恐怖的存在。
道道气息，即便让现在的许渊，都感觉到了心惊。
所谓仙，在这些存在面前，似乎也不过是蝼蚁。
而此时，无数魔种，正从其中冲出，遮天蔽日。
随着魔种出现，这片墨色海洋似乎正在蒸发。
许渊当即有所猜测。
看来所谓魔种，其实便是这片诡异海洋的海水所化。
许渊艺高人胆大。
竟是一步跨出，便出现在了海面正上方。
旋即，用手捧起一些黑色海水，凑到眼前看了看。
当即，他的面色微微凝重起来。
他可以确定，这海水之中，有神魔的气息。
而且，其中还存在无尽的凶戾之气。

似乎与天玄宇宙魔族的魔气极为相似。
不过却要更为恐怖。
据说魔族当年是人族异变而成。
难不成，这场异变，与神魔有关？
许渊猜测到这。
便没有继续再想。
毕竟他所得知的信息并不算多。
只能等下次有机会。
回去找魔主再询问一番了。
想到此处。
许渊又猜测，此地是一处神魔陨落之地？
不过很快，却又将其否定。
最主要还是因为，此地并没有丝毫战斗痕迹。
如若此地是神魔陨落之地，不该是这番模样。
许渊随手将墨色海水，重新洒入大海之中。
面色略显凝重起来。
content_en:
After a while.
A sword light rushed directly into the unknown.
Xu Yuan looked around.
It was discovered that this planet also has land and oceans.
It’s just that the entire ocean seems to be polluted by something weird.
Appears an inky black color.
And extremely sticky.
In this inky sea that is constantly rolling and squirming, there seems to be some terrifying existence.
The aura made even Xu Yuan feel frightened now.
The so-called immortals seem to be nothing more than ants in front of these existences.
At this time, countless demon species were rushing out of it, covering the sky and the sun.
With the emergence of the demon species, this ink-colored ocean seems to be evaporating.
Xu Yuan immediately made a guess.
It seems that the so-called demon species is actually transformed from the sea water of this strange ocean.
Xu Yuanyi is an expert and bold.
He actually took one step forward and appeared directly above the sea.
Immediately, he picked up some black sea water with his hand and brought it to his eyes to take a look.
Immediately, his expression became slightly solemn.
He was certain that there was the aura of gods and demons in the sea water.
Moreover, there is still endless ferocity in it.
It seems to be very similar to the demonic energy of the Tianxuan universe demon clan.
But it's even more terrifying.
It is said that the demon race was formed by the mutation of the human race.
Is it possible that this change has something to do with gods and demons?
Xu Yuan guessed this.
I didn’t think about it any further.
After all, the information he learned wasn't much.
I can only wait for the next opportunity.
Go back to the Demon Lord and ask again.
Think of this.
Xu Yuan also guessed that this place was a place where gods and demons fell?
But soon, it was denied.
The main reason is that there is no trace of battle here.
If this place was the place where gods and demons fell, it shouldn't look like this.
Xu Yuan casually sprinkled the ink-colored sea water into the sea again.
His face became slightly solemn.
